title: NashVegas Getaway Large, Lit Private Deck by Lake
description:
Perfect for families, friends or business travelers who'd like a comfy & quiet night's stay after a day on the lake or enjoying Nashville. This one level home is close to the airport, across from the lake and approximately 11 miles from downtown. It features 3 queen beds w/charging ports, fully stocked kitchen, sheets, towels, private backyard, deck, charcoal grill, AT&T Fiber Wifi, 2 Smart TVs (living & primary) k-cup brewer. Rent a boat, walk the greenway! On dead end street, ample parking.

The space
This comfortable 3b/2b bath (one level living) home is located in a quiet, residential neighborhood, approximately 11 miles to Downtown, 3.5 to airport. Walk to the lake for lunch & drinks or rent a boat at Safe Harbor Marina @ Elm Hill. WIFI (fiber), SMART TVs in living room and primary bedroom, extra large back deck with  Weber BBQ grill, private backyard with fire pit, private driveway. Keurig coffee maker, toaster, microwave, washer/dryer, iron & small ironing board, ice cooler & ice packs for picnics and lake events. Each bedroom has a queen bed. All linens & towels supplied and initial toilet paper, shampoo & soaps are provided. There is a private driveway slightly sloped, with room for at least two cars. You may even bring a small boat. The home is the last house on the left of a dead end street.

Guest access
The entire home, it's private backyard with huge tiered deck is yours to enjoy. Located across from Percy Priest Lake and located on a quiet cul-de-sac. Quick access to the airport (5.5 mi.)  Downtown - Uber or Lyft, cabs available (approx 11 miles). Why pay to park?

Weber charcoal grill on huge private deck!

Other things to note
Percy Priest Lake's Elm Hill Marina is right across Bell Rd. Have lunch, dinner & drinks at Shipwreck Cove right on the water. Rent a boat for the day! Bringing your boat or kayak? Launch them just down the street at Hamilton Creek Recreational area nearby - enjoy lakeside picnic areas, BMX Track, mountain & bike trails. Bike or walk Nashville's Greenway! Located off Bell Road a the base of the Percy Priest Dam, this greenway follows the Stone's River and leads you all the way to downtown Nashville.  Also close by is Nashville Shores waterpark. Shower Chair for elderly or disabled located in walk-in closet.
